newsitem.title: USA: PDS Financial gross financing up.
newsitem.headline: PDS Financial gross financing up.

text.p: PDS Financial Corp said Monday gross financing originations for the fourth quarter increased to $12.3 million from $9.4 million in the 1995 period.
PDS, which provides financing and other financial services to casino operators and gaming equipment manufacturers, said its SlotLease program has been well received by the gaming industry.
SlotLease, a specialized leasing program for slot machines and other electronic gaming devices, allowed PDS to increase its lease portfolio to $24.4 million in 1996, up from $5.5 million in 1995.
The SlotLease program provides recurring revenues and improving profit margins, and also results in a dramatic increase in depreciation as a noncash charge, PDS said.

Earlier, PDS reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.03 a share, down from $0.05 a year ago. Revenues rose to $2.5 million from $1.2 million. Depreciation in the quarter was $1.2 million, up from $290,000 a year ago.
